results.title: Charles Gounod: Faust @ Bavarian State Opera, Munich
results.original_title: Charles Gounod : Faust Opéra national de Bavière, Munich
results.overview: Gounod's Faust at the Bavarian State Opera: Jonathan Tetelman plays Faust, the scholar who makes a pact with Mephistopheles (Kyle Ketelsen) before seducing Marguerite (Olga Kulchynska). The unfortunate woman descends into madness but ultimately achieves redemption. Lotte de Beer directs this production, which marks Nathalie Stutzmann's debut in Munich as conductor.

results.title: Party Pooper
results.overview: Days after giving birth, Megan must face up to her postpartum poo fears. Armed with a pack of tictacs, her sister Sophie is determined to do anything she can to get Megan from the toilet to a night out.

results.title: Speechless
results.overview: In 2017, Emmy-winning documentary filmmaker Ric Esther Bienstock set out to investigate campus free speech controversies - and uncovered an ideological war reshaping universities and democracy itself. With secret recordings, raw phone footage, and unprecedented access to professors, administrators and students on the front lines, Speechless is an eight-year investigation into how pressure from the Left inside campuses provoked a fierce counteroffensive from the Right - turning higher education into a political battleground and exposing what’s lost when debate gives way to dogma.

results.title: Weird Valley
results.overview: Weird Valley is an absurd comedy anthology hosted by a foul-mouthed, philosophizing Poop Bucket puppet who introduces a series of bizarre stories set in a strange Midwestern town where nothing—and no one—is quite right.

results.title: My Name
results.overview: South Korea, 1998: While the country moves closer towards democracy, Young-oak remains at odds with his female-connotated name while attending a boy's school where the air is thick with testosterone. The young man is struggling to fit in and find a new name among corrupt teachers and the teenagers' violent power games, which are as subtle as they are extreme. Behind his mother Jeong-sun's seemingly unflappable exterior, a past long repressed is reemerging, which she is reluctant to face. Yet confrontation is unavoidable – and it leads back to the national tragedy surrounding the Jeju Uprising of April 3rd, 1948.

results.title: Obeso Mórbido
results.overview: In this semi-autobiographical drama, filmmaker Diego Bauer plays a fictionalized version of himself confronting his past and present during a drastic weight-loss journey. As his body changes, he revisits memories of childhood, family, and social stigma, while questioning masculinity, desire, and belonging. Alongside this process, he reflects on his bisexuality and attraction to male and female bodies, exposing confusion, vulnerability, and self-acceptance. Blending fiction and confession, the film follows his attempt to reconcile who he was with who he is becoming in a society obsessed with norms and appearances.

results.title: CMLL Presenta NJPW Fantastica Mania Mexico 2026
results.original_title: CMLL Presenta NJPW Fantastica Mania Mexico 2026
results.overview: NJPW Fantastica Mania Mexico 2026 took place on June 19, 2026 at Arena México in Mexico City, Mexico, and was the 18th edition of the Fantastica Mania series, featuring wrestlers from Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) and New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW).

results.title: Harvest
results.overview: Based on the extraordinary true story of a German Baron in desperate need of a heart transplant. In spite of astonishing circumstances, he goes on a journey through the Black Market underbelly to find hope in the darkness.

results.title: Once Again: The Start of it All
results.original_title: Once Again: The Start of it All
results.overview: In the year 2509, Dr. Obi Iheuche, a brilliant scientist and devoted father, is racing against time to save his terminally ill daughter. As Obi secretly develops a device capable of altering time itself, his work draws the attention of the institution for which he works. This film is an Afro-futurist meditation on fatherhood, memory, and the cost of love under unforgiving systems.

results.title: A Shot at Art
results.overview: Every summer, seasoned volunteers and friends Helen (67) and Peggy (64) give their all for the prestigious festival Art at Sea. This year promises to be special, as they have been assigned to scan tickets at the Hangar.

results.title: The Boy at the Edge of the World
results.overview: Omul lives with his family on a remote island in the Fire Archipelago. During a beach trip, a storm sweeps Omul and his younger sister Kimi into the sea, where Omul witnesses a mysterious creature threatening Kimi’s soul.  Rescued by a whale, the siblings survive, but Kimi is left in a coma. Omul’s ability to talk to animals becomes crucial as he and his brother – who blames him for the accident – set out to find Sadumea, the mythical figure behind Kimi’s torment.  With their dog Tela, they embark on a dangerous expedition deep into the island to save Kimi…

results.title: Лето в Бадене
results.overview: A Soviet intellectual is engaged in science and medicine, writing for himself. His only son decides to leave the country forever, breaking his heart and ruining his career and social standing. Having lost everything, he decides to write a novel about Dostoevsky, the subject he's been dreaming about his whole life. Like his beloved writer, he must lose completely in order to be reborn.

results.title: Dragongate USA: The Gate Of Sin City
results.original_title: Dragongate USA: The Gate Of Sin City
results.overview: High-speed technical wrestling and legendary tradition collide in the heart of the desert as Dragongate USA presents The Gate Of Sin City, a premier event held at the Horseshoe Las Vegas as part of The Collective 2026.

results.title: Disco Sex Machine : La naissance du porn chic
results.original_title: Disco Sex Machine : La naissance du porn chic
results.overview: "120 beats per minute—at this tempo, twice as fast as the human heartbeat, disco music gets the blood pumping and revs up the libido. In the 1970s, when eroticism took over the silver screen and sex ceased to be a purely private matter, disco became the soundtrack of the sexual revolution. A film about the surprising connections between disco and pornography—and how erotic content increasingly found its way into pop culture.

results.title: PAD
results.overview: Carla got her period. Unfortunately, it happened on a swim day at the lake with her dad.

results.title: RevPro High Stakes 2026
results.overview: High Stakes 2026 was a professional wrestling event produced by Revolution Pro Wrestling (RevPro) that took place on March 21, 2026, at The Hangar in Wolverhampton, West Midlands, England. The show was headlined by Jay Joshua (c) vs. 1 Called Manders for the Undisputed British Heavyweight Championship.

results.title: Long Day's Journey into Night
results.overview: Over the course of a day, a married couple, Mary and James Tyrone, and their two sons, Jamie and Edmund, grapple with Mary's morphine addiction and confront each other over the past in a series of emotionally tense and volatile exchanges.

results.title: Superthings: La película
results.overview: When everyday objects suddenly come to life as superheroes and villains, an ordinary world is transformed into the extraordinary universe of SuperThings! Inspired by the internationally acclaimed Spanish toy brand.
